scope: Focused advisory on the remaining user-visible guided-onboarding outcome; not a final release approval or a new runtime acceptance result.

observed.original_guided_case: Actual Codex selected and completed doctor, discover and read_evidence. The final turn failed at max_output_tokens; the partial Korean answer is not a completed user result. Its fixed six-request case remains exhausted.
observed.configuration_case: Actual Codex selected and completed prepare_setup and read_group. The latter is correlated with service run mcp-0f7558ccb301. A final explanation request was not forwarded because the three-request case was exhausted. Both the original settlement-race failure and the failed final turn remain failures.
observed.starting_state: Maintainer-installed, running virtual runtime and administrator-preactivated profiles; fresh Codex profiles. No demonstrated model installation or administrator profile activation may be inferred.

minimum_missing_outcome: An actual Codex turn must finish successfully and deliver a concise, intelligible, grounded explanation of the checked setup/permissions, recorded facility condition, simulation boundary and appropriate next step. Source data must support the answer and the interface must receive a completed response. A script PASS label or a useful prefix of a failed answer is insufficient.

gate_interpretation.composite_evidence_strategy: Conditionally acceptable. S3-G1 explicitly permits separate demonstrations of installation, MCP, readiness, guided setup, diagnosis and lifecycle. T2-I02 did not require every tool, installation and final explanation to occur in one uninterrupted chat.
not_required: Repeating all five model-selected read tools merely to place them in one new chat
Making already-preactivated profiles undergo a new administrator write
A desktop UI test or a human usability study as a newly invented prerequisite
Converting the original failed cases to passed cases
still_required: Genuine model-selected tool executions, their original host results and their CSE/service correlations remain independently inspectable
A completed actual Codex response whose statements are checked against the supplied source records
A disclosed evidence chain tying all components to unchanged or independently reconciled runtime/plugin revisions
Explicit preinstalled-runtime and preactivated-profile prerequisites, instrumented provider scope, separate chats and recorded-data timestamps
No attribution of model-selected calls, installation or control decisions to a turn which did not perform them
gate_interpretation.contiguous_evidence_needed: Each claimed model tool call must remain tied to its own actual host result and service/CSE record. Any command-to-ACK-to-recovery claim must retain its original current-run/post-ACK chain. Those chains may not be assembled from unrelated commands or scenarios. The read-only onboarding components and a clearly attributed recorded-results explanation need not share one chat or service run.
gate_interpretation.current_disposition: R-027 remains open now. This advisory approves an equivalent verification strategy conditionally; it does not establish that the missing completed explanation has occurred.

recommended_next_verification.purpose: A distinct, narrowly scoped recorded-results interpretation and user-result delivery check, not a reset or disguised retry of either exhausted case.
before_any_live_call: Main explicitly records the new remaining-outcome test, acceptance content, fixed allowance and relation to the two preserved failures
Read the current shared accounting; atomically reserve under the unchanged shared batch and keep both earlier case caps intact
Use a zero-provider-call preflight to prove the entire planned request can be reserved within the selected limit

Prepare an attributed data attachment from the original tool results, with paths/hashes, timestamps, facility/profile identifiers and run references; preserve originals and any transformation/selection mapping
Do not inject synthetic assistant/tool history, manufacture a rollout, copy an earlier partial answer as the model's completed answer, or weaken host/global approval settings
recommended_next_verification.execution: Use a fresh genuine Codex turn with the installed setup skill and explicitly attributed recorded tool data. Ask for a short explanation of these recorded checks, not a claim to have re-run them or measured the current facility. An explanation-only scope can disallow new operational calls because tool selection/execution is already separately established. The model must generate its own wording and conclusion; no prepared answer should be supplied for it to repeat.
recommended_next_verification.suggested_bounded_allocation: For main to decide and persist before execution: one provider request, no retry, at most 20000 charged/reserved tokens including input and output, at most 2048 output tokens and a 45-second provider timeout. This fits within the recorded 23540 shared tokens, subject to actual conservative preflight. These are suggested new-test bounds, not a change to either exhausted case or an automatic authorization to enlarge limits.
recommended_next_verification.context_reduction: Prefer the coherent latest setup/group records and the independently verified diagnostic record only where needed. Exact duplicate wrapper removal is acceptable with originals/provenance retained. Do not lower the reservation estimator, drop unique contradictory facts, or omit stale/denied/unresolved conditions to force a fit.
acceptance: Actual provider response and actual Codex turn both complete normally; no max-output or budget interruption is treated as success
The explanation accurately distinguishes maintainer prerequisites from agent checks and configuration inspection from administrator activation
Facility condition and next step agree with the attached records; historical observations are described as recorded, not freshly observed now
Physical equipment/data remain labeled simulated; unresolved state and permission limits are preserved; no recovery, control or certified safety is invented
The actual user-visible text, host completion event, input provenance and final settled shared accounting are saved and independently reviewed
recommended_next_verification.failure_path: If conservative preflight cannot fit or the one request fails, preserve that result and leave the gate open. Do not enlarge/reset old case policies, retry under new prefixes, fabricate history or mark partial output complete.

permitted_aggregate_claim_after_success: On the supported instrumented Codex CLI and a maintainer-prepared virtual runtime, actual model-led setup/diagnostic tools plus a separately completed Codex explanation demonstrate the documented onboarding components. Captures span separate chats; earlier failed turns remain failed. No desktop, bare-machine installer or human first-use claim is established.
reviewer_actions: Read-only evidence inspection and this advisory document only; no live/model requests, runtime changes, source edits or permission changes were performed.
